title: Steering Externalities: Benign Activation Steering Unintentionally Increases Jailbreak Risk for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus is on safety vulnerabilities, specifically how benign activation steering to improve utility (like compliance or JSON formatting) can unintentionally increase a model's susceptibility to jailbreak attacks.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The research is focused on the technical aspects of LLM safety and alignment, demonstrating that optimizing for benign utility can degrade safety.
